resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Nynorsk pass identified 25 actionable Bokmål residues and mixed-language defects in electrical, circuit, trigonometric, thermal, and unit terminology; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage bullet retained Bokmål forms for increase and decrease.
evidence: The previous text used ‘øker’ and ‘reduseres’ in Nynorsk content.
findings.resolution: Changed the sentence to ‘aukar’ and ‘minkar’.

findings.summary: The practical-safety paragraph mixed Bokmål forms with Nynorsk terminology.
evidence: It used komponenter, tilkoblinger, tilstrekkelig, virkelige, batterier, and strømforsyninger.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with Nynorsk component, connection, margin, battery, and supply terms.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition used the Bokmål verb gir.
evidence: The previous sentence began ‘Ei seriekopling gir’.
findings.resolution: Changed gir to the Nynorsk form gjev.

findings.summary: The current-law title used the Bokmål compound strømlov.
evidence: The title was ‘Kirchhoffs strømlov’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Kirchhoffs straumlov’.

findings.summary: The current-law example used an awkward phrase for the remaining branch currents.
evidence: The previous wording said the branches had to ‘føre til saman 5 A ut’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as the other branches carrying 5 A out in total.

findings.summary: The trigonometry summary used the Bokmål form Vinkler.
evidence: The summary began ‘Vinkler, lengder’.
findings.resolution: Changed Vinkler to the Nynorsk form Vinklar.

findings.summary: The sine formula used the Bokmål geometric term motstående.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘motståande’ inconsistently with the example’s Bokmål label.
findings.resolution: Standardized the expression as ‘motståande / hypotenuse’.

findings.summary: The cosine formula used the Bokmål geometric term hosliggende.
evidence: The previous expression used the Bokmål label hosliggende.
findings.resolution: Standardized the expression as ‘hosliggjande / hypotenuse’.

findings.summary: The opposite-side example formula retained the Bokmål label motstående.
evidence: The example used ‘motstående’ while surrounding prose was Nynorsk.
findings.resolution: Changed the label to motståande.

findings.summary: The adjacent-side example formula retained the Bokmål label hosliggende.
evidence: The example used ‘hosliggende’ while surrounding prose was Nynorsk.
findings.resolution: Changed the label to hosliggjande.

findings.summary: The degrees-and-radians title used the Bokmål form radianer.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Grader og radianer’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Grader og radianar’.

findings.summary: The angle-mode warning was largely Bokmål.
evidence: It used være, riktig, brukes, and annet in Nynorsk content.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the warning with vere, rett, blir brukt, anna, and heil.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity description used the Bokmål verb beskriver and passive form trengs.
evidence: The previous description used ‘beskriver hvor mye energi som trengs’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Nynorsk skildrar and trengst.

findings.summary: The basic-relationships title was Bokmål.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Grunnleggende sammenhenger’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Grunnleggjande samanhengar’.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference bullet used Bokmål En and forskjell.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘En temperaturforskjell ... en forskjell’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Ein temperaturskilnad ... ein skilnad’.

findings.summary: The worked-example title used the Bokmål form Regneeksempel.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Regneeksempel’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Rekneeksempel’.

findings.summary: The water example used the Bokmål noun vann.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Oppvarming av vann’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Oppvarming av vatn’.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity conclusion was written in Bokmål.
evidence: It used en, virkelig, varmeovn, and trenger.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the conclusion as Nynorsk with ein, verkeleg, varmeomn, and treng.

findings.summary: The object-and-material paragraph mixed Bokmål verbs, articles, and nouns.
evidence: It used gjelder, avhenger, hvor mye, en materialegenskap, and samme.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with gjeld, avheng, kor mykje, materialeigenskap, and same.

findings.summary: The heat-loss limitations paragraph retained Bokmål forms.
evidence: It used ligningen, antar, et, gjøre, and avviker.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with likninga, føreset, eit, gjere, and avvik.

findings.summary: The heat-flux description used the Bokmål verb beskriver and from-form fra.
evidence: The previous description began ‘Varmestrøm beskriver’ and ended ‘fra en overflate’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to skildrar and frå ei overflate.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example used Bokmål article and noun forms.
evidence: The previous setup said ‘En varmeovn’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Ein varmeomn’.

findings.summary: The conduction note used Bokmål angir and strømning.
evidence: The previous text said ‘Minustegnet angir strømning’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Minusteiknet viser straum’.

findings.summary: The practical heat-flux check mixed Bokmål forms and used an awkward noun.
evidence: It used Skill and oppvarmingen in a Nynorsk list.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with Skil, gjennomsnittleg, and oppvarminga.

findings.summary: The practical heat-flux check used the Bokmål form nødvendig.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with ‘når det er nødvendig’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘når det er naudsynt’.
